description: This PHP source file defines the ViewSearchView class, which extends ViewListView. It handles rendering and interactions for a search view within the ModuleBuilder component of SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It includes methods for constructing the UI, handling AJAX requests, and module title parameters.

classes.name: ViewSearchView
classes.description: A class extending ViewListView to manage the display and AJAX interactions of the search view in SuiteCRM's ModuleBuilder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view and sets the layout for editing if specified in the request.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of titles for the module, including the module name and title.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overridden to prevent default behavior, intentionally left empty.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search view, either as a preview or full AJAX content, using Smarty templates.

methods.name: constructAjax
methods.description: Builds the AJAX navigation breadcrumb trail and sets the view title based on context.
